7874-8043-8350.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
7874-8043-8350.description:
Cast Face Yourself for free due to Vision, targeting yourself and creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste and the noted exile clause.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the The Immortal Weapons token enters, it triggers, returning Face Yourself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2577-4871-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional Zombie.
You control another Zombie.
2577-4871-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2577-4871-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3967-4186-6012--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 5.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

967-5220-5256-7855--180.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Goblin, Orc or Army.
967-5220-5256-7855--180.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat

1895-4399-4770-6823.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Aunt May trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Aunt May trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4770-6823.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1594-4399-4518-6097.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Hinterland Sanctifier trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4399-4518-6097.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2999-7690-7743--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2999-7690-7743--165.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

104-6458-7690--165.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
104-6458-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

3809-4222-4917-5184.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two other artifact creatures.
3809-4222-4917-5184.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure, creating two 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.
3809-4222-4917-5184.notes: Once you have infinite mana and Treasure tokens, you can use Jan Jansen's second ability, paired with untapping it, infinitely to get infinite Construct tokens.

457-1792-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1792-7340.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping a creature you control.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Sewer-veillance Cam, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the creature tapped in step 5.
Repeat from step 2.
457-1792-7340.notes:
If you control an artifact creature, you can untap that creature with the additional Sewer-veillance Cam trigger. It can then be tapped by Urza for blue mana, which can then be used for Urza's other ability.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

5256-5702-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

147-2511-6476.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
147-2511-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

467-1636.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
467-1636.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
467-1636.description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
When the Pilot enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

413-710-4775.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Danitha trigger, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact Creature that is a Gnome and/or Artificer

2292-2527-4073-4917--75.notablePrerequisites:
Jan Jansen and the additional Gnome or Artificer do not have a +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one additional artifact creature.
2292-2527-4073-4917--75.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature you control except the Gnome or Artificer.
Jan Jansen triggers, causing it and creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jan Jansen.
When Jan Jansen dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Gnome or Artificer.
When the Gnome or Artificer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Jan Jansen and the other Gnome or Artificer, giving a creature -2/-2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 4.

2921-4871-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1283-2092-4929-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's second ability by paying {1}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
1283-2092-4929-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

178-1849-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
178-1849-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

864-1312-2034-4359-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

104-2060-4222-5162.notablePrerequisites:
Cleric Class is at least level two.
Kwain does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Kwain.
104-2060-4222-5162.description:
Activate Kwain by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and gain 2 life, and allowing each opponent to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kwain.
Repeat.

1486-1995-2713-4549.notablePrerequisites: Gauntlets of Light attached to Magda.
1486-1995-2713-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Magda, adding {W}.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {W}, untapping Magda.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

404-3604-4364.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
404-3604-4364.description:
Cast Aurelia by paying {2}{R}{R}{W}{W}.
When Aurelia enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aurelia.
Move to your combat phase.
Declare Ghired and an Aurelia that has not attacked this turn as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a token copy of the Aurelia token that enters the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Aurelia trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control, and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 4 each combat phase.

2034-2793-3582-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Kaya's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Ugin's Nexus.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding {C}{C}.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Ugin's Nexus triggers, returning itself from exile to your hand, and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

1170-1414-2456.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Tezzeret.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Tezzeret's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

418-2428-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Ocular Halo attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
418-2428-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to draw a card.
When you draw a card, Horizon Chimera will trigger, gaining you 1 life.
Gaining the life untaps Famished Paladin.
Repeat.

1283-3157-3389.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Flickering Ward enchanting a creature.
Pay for Talisman to untap Chromatic Orrery.
Return Flickering Ward to hand using its ability.

1323-3814-3995.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
You control up to two lands that can produce a total of at least {U}{U}.
1323-3814-3995.description:
Activate up to two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Horseshoe Crab.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Argothian Elder.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Argothian Elder's ability by tapping it, untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 5.

1420-1636.notablePrerequisites: Godsire does not have summoning sickness.
1420-1636.description:
Tap Godsire to create an 8/8 beast token.
When the token ETBs, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat for infinite tokens.
